## Findings

### Must-Fix

**CONCERN-1 — Preserve the ONCE-bounded-respawn invariant on the lean-twin rung.** Plan v2's proposed inserts to CLAUDE.md line 151 and SKILL.md Step 5b Autocompact-thrash respawn recipe both add a lean-twin escalation clause, but neither explicitly carries the "ONE lean-twin respawn per role+round+version, same v<n>, no counter increment" invariant that Step 5b item 4 already applies to the CURRENT micro-scoped-default respawn. Without that language the new rung could be read as licensing unbounded lean-twin retries (each thrashing in turn), inverting the fail-loud bound the current ladder maintains. FIX: extend both inserts with the explicit ONCE-bounded language mirroring item 4's phrasing — CLAUDE.md addition should read "…escalate ONCE (same v<n>, no counter increment; the lean twin gets the same one-bounded-respawn budget as item 4) to the role's LEAN TWIN with the same micro-scoped brief"; SKILL.md addition names the same invariant. Severity: CONCERN (correctness — ladder invariant weakened silently).

**CONCERN-2 — Fixed leading token on the independence-loss `epm:progress` note for grep-discoverability.** Plan v2 proposes the note body `session-composed <role> inline after lean-twin respawn also thrashed; round <n>` — no fixed leading token. Every other CLAUDE.md-durable-marker convention on this project uses a fixed leading token for grep-based discovery by future filers, /daily sweeps, and dashboard consumers: `followup-parked-by-cap` (Step 9a-ter cap-park), `merge-hold-candidate` (Step 2b edit-locus WARN), `[long-phase-heartbeat]` (Step 6d.2 heartbeat), `[gpu-idle-advisory]` (Step 6d.2 GPU-idle), `[phase-rate]` (Step 6d.2 rate/ETA), `[gate-fleet]` (Step 9c gate arbitration), `deliberate-stop ` prefix on Step 0 guard exits. Without a fixed lead the independence-loss notes are not efficiently discoverable ("grep -F 'session-composed' events.jsonl" would work but drift-prone if wording changes). FIX: prescribe a fixed leading token — recommend `[epm-inline-fallback] role=<role> round=<n> reason=<one-line>` mirroring the `[long-phase-heartbeat]` shape, single-line, greppable. Update both AC4 (CLAUDE.md addition) and AC5 (SKILL.md item-4 amendment) to name the exact token in the contract. Severity: CONCERN (durability + discoverability of the fix's own failure surface).

### Nits (opportunistic — don't block; implementer may absorb without a round)

**NIT-1 — planner-lean's specific-skill list will go stale.** The planner-lean prose says "Skills the spec invokes (plan-compute-sizing, paper-plots) — follow their file conventions by direct Read, not by Skill-invoking." If the sibling planner.md later declares additional skills (as it may — the `skills:` block on other roles has grown historically), the twin's note lags. Compress to "the skills the sibling spec declares — follow their SKILL.md file conventions by direct Read, not by Skill-invoking" and drop the specific names; the sibling spec is where the specific list lives.
